How B Corp Certification Is Reshaping Business Education - and What It Means for the Next Generation of Managers

More than 10,800 companies across 102 countries and 163 industries now hold B Corp certification, employing over one million people between them. This year the movement turned 20, and the first companies began certifying under B Lab's revised global standards.
